label: GO step after a rewarded trial that reached S1, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 covers 99.98% of activations and 100% of mass). It never fires at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before about episode trial 40 (98.5% of mass is at ep_trial >= 50, and the rate keeps rising to trial 80-99). Within that window it prefers a previous reward that came from S1 (prev_state==1); it fires with the a1 policy (model_act==1 lift 5.1x, choice logit > 8 lift 5.4x) and at low value (value < 7.1). Magnitude is highest for the first reward after a loss: in top windows, trial t-1 was unrewarded and trial t was rewarded in S1, often via a rare transition (a2 -> S1). Adding tv(prev_reward,-1)==0 raises precision to 0.76 but drops recall to 0.44, so the feature is weak but present during long reward streaks. Dev scores: the simplest predicate (GO & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial>=50) has F1 0.33 and mass recall 0.985; the recorded one has F1 0.54, mass recall 0.82, precision 0.41. Uses only observed variables. The ep_trial dependence is unusual and probably reflects slow drift in the hidden state over the episode.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S1 r, a1 S1 r, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
